learning_objective: 🎯 Realize the incredible power of words! Understand how they can act as weapons to hurt, or as medicine to heal, and why we must choose them wisely.

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: जो वापस न लिया जा सके

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A physical wound heals over time, but harsh, insulting, or angry words can leave a scar on someone's heart forever. Words can pierce deeper than swords.
On the flip side, words of encouragement, love, and apology have the power to heal broken relationships, boost confidence, and bring joy to someone's darkest days.
Once a word leaves your mouth, it cannot be taken back. Like an arrow shot from a bow, an uttered word is irreversible. Therefore, thinking before speaking is a vital life skill.
Using words properly allows us to share our deepest thoughts, write beautiful poetry, and connect with humanity. It is the greatest gift given to humans.

fun_activity.title: 🛑 The Toothpaste Test
fun_activity.instructions: Squeeze out some toothpaste onto a plate. Now, try to put all the toothpaste back into the tube perfectly. You can't! Spoken words are exactly like that toothpaste. Choose them carefully!

exam_tips: 📌 Contrast the destructive power of harsh words with the constructive power of kind words.
📌 Explain the metaphor: 'Words can cut deeper than a knife'.
📌 Write about a personal experience or textual reference where a single positive word changed a situation.
quick_recap: ⭐ The tongue has no bones, but it is strong enough to break a heart.
⭐ Encouraging words can motivate someone to achieve greatness.
⭐ Thoughtful communication is the foundation of respect and peace in society.
